summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, disclosing that the Israel Innovation Authority approved a grant of approximately $1.8 million to its subsidiary LightSolver Ltd. to advance the all-optical Laser Processing Unit computing platform. No securities transaction, ownership change, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation or closing date is stated; the program covers next-generation hardware, LPU Lab algorithm expansion and HPC integration. This is a routine government grant and R&D update, not a special situation; watch commercialization milestones and IIA royalty obligations rather than any arbitrage angle.
